scope: WPS diagnostics only; no UI changes or changes to PIN candidates, wireless tuning, source addresses, attack parameters or cleanup ownership.
architecture: A shared allowlisted WpsDiagnosticTrace writes through existing asynchronous bounded LogHistory. Existing capture feedback export includes current-run/wps-diagnostics.txt and previous-run/wps-diagnostics.txt. No second persistent cache is introduced.
coverage: Target ordinal and hashed task correlation; mode, channel, band and safe numeric limits. No SSID, BSSID, source address or raw command is recorded.
Preparation stages, skip reasons, initialization failures, native protocol milestones and numeric failure codes.
Normal, quick, offline and combination routes; normal completion, timeout, cancellation, start failure, stop failure and wireless restoration.
One final existing bounded log-tail read after stopping the process; failure is recorded without replacing the primary exception.
privacy: Native lines are projected to fixed event names and validated numeric/version values before reaching history. Recovered PINs, passwords, authentication keys and packet bodies are not retained.
limitations: Sampled overlapping log tails are not a complete packet capture or exact retry counts. Timeline limit and empty/unavailable reads are explicit. Final sample and terminal status remain recorded after the native event limit.
History retention, snapshot/export byte budgets and disk/queue failure may omit records; existing run-history metadata reports storage loss.
Existing feedback archives and already-cleaned native logs cannot be reconstructed.

compatibility.applicability: Local projection and persistence are shared Windows/Debian Python logic. Final read reuses the existing read_log_tail command and bounds; no new OpenWrt command syntax or driver requirement.
compatibility.conclusion: Exact cached source hashes verified; RX_TIMEOUT=2 and KEY_REJECTED=1 remain distinct. No claim of live router or all-driver validation.

acceptance: Restart the source application, run one authorized target, cancel or allow completion, export capture feedback and inspect wps-diagnostics.txt. On Debian 12 also verify history write permissions, export and clean exit.
